name: CLIProxyAPI
description: 把正在运行的 CLIProxyAPI 服务接入模型选择：添加服务后填入 API Key，模型列表从服务自身的 /v1/models 自动发现（上下文窗口、思考强度与输入模态随发现写入），选中的模型自动经该服务路由；服务端按模型自动适配上游协议（Claude 走 Anthropic、GPT 走 Responses、Gemini 走原生），对桌面始终是一个 chat-completions 端点。基地址与 API 格式可在设置中修改（默认 http://127.0.0.1:8317/v1），适配自托管部署的地址差异。

en.name: CLIProxyAPI
en.description: Connect a running CLIProxyAPI server to the model picker: after adding the service and pasting its API key, the model list is discovered from the server's own /v1/models endpoint (context window, thinking efforts, and input modalities are captured with it) and every selected model routes through the server automatically. Protocol adaptation per model happens server-side (Claude via Anthropic, GPT via Responses, Gemini native); the desktop always sees one chat-completions endpoint. The base URL and API format are editable in Settings (default http://127.0.0.1:8317/v1) for self-hosted deployments on another address.
